Registry DisplayVersion differs by installer type ('26.03' EXE vs '26.03.00.0' MSI) though both normalise equal; FileVersion is first in HR-12 trust order.

ownerApprovals.what: userExeRelPaths left empty (no documented per-user install folder); per-user MSI copies are still found through the loaded-hive HKU uninstall scan while the user is signed in (inference, to confirm in Gate 4)
ownerApprovals.question: userExeRelPaths: no evidence of a per-user install location. The vendor EXE installer is all-users only (7zipInstall.c: '#define g_AllUsers True', writes HKLM Uninstall\7-Zip) and winget lists only machine-scope installers, but the vendor MSI sets ALLUSERS=2 (DOC/7zip.wxs), so a per-user MSI install is possible and its folder is not documented. Proposed: leave userExeRelPaths empty (a per-user-only copy would then report NOT_INSTALLED instead of SKIPPED_USER_SCOPE; nothing is changed either way). Owner to confirm or supply a path.
